reason: Adds a hover-revealed, two-step archive control to workspace sidebar session rows and removes the archive action from the overflow menu while preserving other row actions.

summaries.zh: 在工作区侧边栏会话行中提供悬停显示的两步归档按钮，并将归档选项移出更多菜单。
summaries.en: Adds a hover-revealed two-step archive button to workspace sidebar session rows and removes the archive option from the overflow menu.

capabilities: Modifies the workspace sidebar session-row interface
Hides the archive option from the session overflow menu
Invokes the host archive-session action after a two-step user confirmation
